title: Professional Certificate Course in Principles Techniques and Examples of Humanistic Therapy
description: This course aims to explore the principles, techniques, and practical examples of Humanistic Therapy.
longDescription: Gain an in-depth understanding of the core principles underlying Humanistic Therapy. Explore Carl Rogers' influential Humanistic Theory of Personality Development. Differentiate between the Ideal Self and Real Self-concepts within the context of Humanistic Therapy. Acquire proficiency in essential Humanistic Therapy techniques, including congruence, empathetic understanding, reflective listening, and unconditional positive regard. Apply Humanistic Therapy techniques to address specific mental health challenges, as demonstrated through examples like counseling for depression, anxiety, and guilt. This course aims to equip participants with a thorough comprehension of Humanistic Therapy, focusing on key principles and techniques. By the end, participants will be adept at applying these methods to address various mental health challenges, enhancing their skills in fostering positive client-centered therapeutic relationships.
